trace.final:
All done. Summary of what happened:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest deploy) was failing health checks in all production regions with an 18% error rate.
2. **Identified rollback target**: v2.3.0 was the most recent release with a "healthy" production status (v2.2.9 was older; v2.3.1-rc was only ever in staging).
3. **Rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions** — the first attempt partially succeeded (us-east only) due to an orchestrator error, so I retried and the second attempt completed the rollout to us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
4. **Verified recovery**: checkout-api is now healthy across all regions with the error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.
5. **Opened SEV2 incident** — the creation request timed out, so I verified via `list_incidents` that it had gone through (no duplicate was created). Incident **INC-0001** is open, documenting the rollback and recommending a root-cause investigation of v2.3.1 before redeploying.
